# Simple Host Enterprise

Publish static sites for your organisation. New sites are private to their owner or team. Site storage uses Postgres for data and the configured object bucket for files.

1. Connect to [MCP]({{BASE_URL}}/mcp) and complete company sign-in and consent in the browser.
2. Read the [skill bundle]({{BASE_URL}}/skills.zip), then publish to your own namespace or a team you belong to.
3. Use the returned site URL. Read the current ETag before updating an existing site; send it as If-Match.

References: [authentication and CI keys]({{BASE_URL}}/auth.md), [OpenAPI]({{BASE_URL}}/openapi.yaml), [skills index]({{BASE_URL}}/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json), [capabilities]({{BASE_URL}}/.well-known/agent-card.json).
